headline: Binance Resumes Bitcoin Withdrawals After Stolen $6.3B Covered
summary: Binance has resumed bitcoin withdrawals after covering the bulk of $6.3 billion stolen in an attack attributed by the FBI to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making its operational liquidity central to broader digital asset market functioning.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The restoration of withdrawals and the absorption of losses by Binance alleviate immediate liquidity and contagion panic.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin stabilized and recovered ground as Binance's resumption of customer withdrawals removed fears of an extended liquidity freeze.
